pd_test: Add a delay between iterations on hard reset test After performing an iteration of hard reset, DUT may continue to negotiate a higher >5V voltage. Some check on the next iteration will see DUT/PDTester being in some transitional state and fail. This CL add a delay between iterations so the >5V negotiation completes before the next iteration. BUG=b:131840808 TEST=Ran firmware_PDResetHard multiple time and passed consistently. This was meant to support non-test devices, but today just pushing local_test_runner and test bundles are not enough to run tests on non-test devices; for example, all software dependencies are unavailable due to missing /usr/local/etc/tast_use_flags.txt, some tests depend on helper C binaries that are only available on test images, and so on. hci: Choose legacy advertising over extended advertising commands. Bluetooth 5.0 (Vol 2, Part E, section 3.1.1) disallows mixing of legacy and extended advertising commands. However, there is no command to explicitly choose which mode (legacy or extended) the host wants to use, but rather the first advertising command will determine whether legacy or extended advertising commands will be allowed for the rest of the controller's lifetime (until Reset). So we call an arbitrary read-only legacy advertising command very early to tell the controller that we want to use the legacy advertising commands instead of extended advertising commands. Without specifying legacy vs extended commands very early, we might hit an unexpected Command Disallowed later on. For example, LE Set Scan Parameters hits Command Disallowed error on Thunder Peak. BUG=chromium:971710 TEST=Manual scanning test on atlas (Thunder Peak). Change-Id: I1ddf22230260e73d646f3d0b1bc5d6f91c822a61 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1677728 Tested-by: Sonny Sasaka <sonnysasaka@chromium.org> Commit-Ready: Sonny Sasaka <sonnysasaka@chromium.org> Legacy-Commit-Queue: Commit Bot <commit-bot@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Shyh-In Hwang <josephsih@chromium.org>
